dialogues.speaker: Chanil
dialogues.text: I know, I know! I've taken nearly all the baby Saurians in the tribe home at one point or another.

dialogues.speaker: Chanil
dialogues.text: But none of them was able to stay for too long... They all returned to their partners sooner than later.

dialogues.speaker: Chanil
dialogues.text: Actually, now that you mention it, I don't think any of their grown-up partners had any kind of fancy name...
